name: [UPDATE] Ability Wars
desc:
Welcome to Ability Wars! In this game, you can fight other players using powerful and interesting abilities.
You can unlock abilities through Punches, gained by fighting other players, or Badges, gained by accomplishing tasks.
Later on, empower your abilities through Mastery and become the true Ability Warrior!

NEW CONTENT: Cosmos Mastery Rework
103 abilities currently in the game, alongside 21 masteries.

[Thumbnails by Reversicle, AlexMatts, & NubScrub]
